android.desc:
Kittens Game is a village simulation text game. You manage a village of kittens as they acquire resources and unlock new technologies.

Over 30 different buildings, 50+ resources, hundreds of technologies and upgrades. No ads or micro-transactions!

CONTENT WARNING: 
This game contains scenes of DEATH, LIVE SACRIFICES, ELDRITCH GODS and COSMIC HORROR and is not suitable for kids.
